articles.summary: Grayson is a universal decision model built for real-time decisions across fraud, risk and financial crimes. Send it any context and the questions you need answered, and get a calibrated probability for every answer in under 150 ms of model time for typical requests.
articles.title: Introducing Finic Grayson

articles.summary: We added a decision model's judgment to a traditional credit model. With Grayson, it predicted defaults better on later loans, worth up to $155,000 per 10,000 applications in real loan outcomes. Jev's answers added less.
articles.title: Can a decision model make loan default prediction more accurate?
